name: Shirye-shiryen Lasisin Tuƙin Motocin Kasuwanci (CDL)
objectives: Idan aka ba ku bayanin wani aikin tuƙi, gane ajin CDL (A, B ko C) da duk ƙarin izinin da aikin yake buƙata, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin bayanan ayyuka 5 daidai

Ta amfani da majiyoyin hukuma na FMCSA da na jiha, jera matakai daga gwajin lafiya zuwa jarabawar ƙwarewar CDL a jere daidai, ba tare da wani mataki ya ɓace ba, kuma da lokacin jira da dokar horo a ciki

Ta amfani da littafin CDL na jiharku na kyauta, tsara yadda za ku yi karatu don jarabawar rubutu da kuke buƙata, da ci maki a rukunin tambayoyin gwaji, kuna samun aƙalla 8 cikin 10 a tambayoyin gwaji kafin ku shirya ranar jarabawa

Kuna tsaye kusa da babbar mota ko kuna amfani da hotonta, faɗin sunan kowane sashe da kuke dubawa a binciken mota kafin tafiya, da abin da kuke dubawa a kansa, kuna rufe dukkan manyan wurare a jere ba tare da tsallake wani wuri ba
Idan aka ba ku wani yanayin tuƙi, zaɓar mataki mai lafiya game da tazara, gudu, tuƙin baya da lafiyar direba, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin yanayi 5 daidai

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Ajujuwan CDL da ƙarin izini: wanne kuke buƙata?
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Haɗa aikin tuƙi da ajin CDL da ƙarin izinin da yake buƙata.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku bayanin wani aikin tuƙi, za ku iya gane ajin CDL (A, B ko C) da duk ƙarin izinin da aikin yake buƙata, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin bayanan ayyuka 5 daidai.
Lasisin tuƙin motocin kasuwanci (CDL) yana ba ku damar tuƙa manyan motoci ko motoci na musamman don aiki. Akwai ajujuwa uku, bisa irin motar.
Aji A na motoci masu haɗe ne, kamar tarakta mai jan tirela, idan nauyin haɗin ya kai fam 26,001 ko fiye, kuma tirelar da ake ja ta fi fam 10,000. Aji B na babbar mota ɗaya ce mai nauyin fam 26,001 ko fiye, kamar motar zuba ƙasa (dump truck), motar akwati (box truck) ko bas na birni; tana iya jan ƙaramar tirela mai nauyin fam 10,000 ko ƙasa da haka. Aji C na ƙananan motoci ne masu ɗaukar mutane 16 ko fiye (har da direban), ko masu ɗaukar kayayyaki masu haɗari da ke buƙatar alamun gargaɗi (placards).
Ƙarin izini (endorsements) ƙarin haruffa ne a lasisinku don aiki na musamman. T: tirela biyu ko uku. P: fasinjoji. N: motocin tanki. H: kayayyaki masu haɗari. X: tanki tare da kayayyaki masu haɗari. S: bas na makaranta. Kowanne yana buƙatar nasa jarabawar, kuma izinin H yana kuma buƙatar binciken tarihin tsaro.
Ku fara daga aikin da kuke so. Ku karanta tallace-tallacen ayyuka na gaske kusa da ku, ku nemi ajin da ƙarin izinin da suke nema.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zaɓi aikin da kuke so, kamar tafiya mai nisa, isar da kaya a gari, bas ko motar zuba ƙasa.
- Ku tambaya: tana jan babbar tirela? Yawanci wannan Aji A ne.
- Babbar mota ɗaya ce ko bas? Yawanci wannan Aji B ne.
- Tana ɗaukar fasinjoji, ruwa a tanki, tirela biyu ko kayayyaki masu haɗari? Ku ƙara ƙarin izinin.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- CDL: commercial driver's license: lasisin da ake buƙata don tuƙa manyan motoci ko motoci na musamman don aiki.
- Mota mai haɗe (combination vehicle): babbar mota da ke jan tirela, kamar tarakta da tirela.
- Ma'aunin nauyi (weight rating): mafi yawan nauyin da aka gina mota ta ɗauka idan ta cika da kaya, wanda kamfanin da ya ƙera ta ya ƙayyade (ana yawan kiran sa GVWR).
- Ƙarin izini (endorsement): ƙarin izini a CDL ɗinku don aiki na musamman, kamar ɗaukar fasinjoji ko tanki.
- Kayayyaki masu haɗari (hazmat): kayan da za su iya cutar da mutane ko dukiya, kamar mai ko sinadarai, da ke buƙatar alamun gargaɗi da ake kira placards.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- 49 CFR 383.91: Commercial motor vehicle groups (Cornell LII copy of the federal rule)
- 49 CFR 383.153: Endorsement codes on the CDL and CLP
- FMCSA: Commercial Driver's License (the official federal CDL pages)
Gwada yanzu: Ku nemo tallace-tallacen ayyukan tuƙi na gaske guda uku kusa da ku (a shafin neman aiki ko a shafin kamfanin da kansa). Ga kowanne, ku rubuta aikin, ajin CDL da yake nema da duk ƙarin izini. Ku zagaye aikin da kuka fi so.
Yanzu za ku iya haɗa aikin tuƙi da Aji A, B ko C, da faɗin ƙarin izinin da yake buƙata.

check.q: Wani aiki tuƙin tarakta ne mai jan tirela mai tsawon ƙafa 53. Wane aji ne yawanci?
options: Aji C
Aji B
Aji A
Ba a buƙatar CDL
check.why: Tarakta mai jan tirela mai nauyi mota ce mai haɗe, wato Aji A.

check.q: Wane ƙarin izini za ku ƙara don tuƙa bas na makaranta?
options: S
T
N
X
check.why: S shi ne izinin bas na makaranta; ana kuma buƙatar izinin fasinjoji P don bas.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Matakai daga izinin koyo zuwa lasisi
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Jera matakan samun CDL a jere, da wanda ke kula da kowanne.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da majiyoyin hukuma na FMCSA da na jiha, za ku iya jera matakai daga gwajin lafiya zuwa jarabawar ƙwarewar CDL a jere daidai, ba tare da wani mataki ya ɓace ba, kuma da lokacin jira da dokar horo a ciki.
Yawancin sababbin direbobi suna bin matakai iri ɗaya. Dokokin tarayya daga FMCSA suke; ofishin lasisin tuƙi na jiharku ne ke yin jarabawar kuma yake ƙayyade kuɗi da fom.
Na farko, gwajin lafiya (ana yawan kiran sa DOT physical) daga likitan gwaji mai takardar shaida. Yawancin direbobi dole su sake cin sa aƙalla duk bayan watanni 24. Na biyu, ku ci jarabawar rubutu ta jiha don samun izinin koyon tuƙin motocin kasuwanci (CLP). Dokokin tarayya sun ce mai CLP dole ya kai aƙalla shekara 18, kuma dole ya jira aƙalla kwanaki 14 kafin jarabawar ƙwarewa. Yayin da kuke atisaye a titunan jama'a, dole mai CDL na ajin da ya dace ya zauna kusa da ku.
Tun daga 7 ga Fabrairu, 2022, yawancin mutanen da ke samun CDL na farko na Aji A ko B, ko izinin P, S ko H na farko, dole su kammala horon farko na direbobi (ELDT) a wurin da ke cikin Training Provider Registry na FMCSA kafin jarabawa. Sannan ku yi jarabawar ƙwarewa ta jiha: binciken mota kafin tafiya, sarrafa mota na asali, da tuƙi a titi.
Shekaru: don tuƙi daga wata jiha zuwa wata dole ku kai aƙalla shekara 21. Wasu jihohi suna bar direbobi masu shekara 18 zuwa 20 su yi tuƙi a cikin jihar kaɗai. Ku duba dokokin jiharku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Gwajin lafiya da likitan gwaji mai takardar shaida.
- Ku karanta littafin CDL na jiha, ku ci jarabawar rubutu.
- Ku sami izinin koyon tuƙin motocin kasuwanci (CLP).
- Ku kammala horon farko na direbobi a wurin da ke da rajista, idan ya shafe ku.
- Ku yi atisaye tare da mai CDL da ya cancanta kusa da ku; ku jira aƙalla kwanaki 14.
- Ku yi jarabawar ƙwarewa: binciken mota kafin tafiya, sarrafa mota na asali, tuƙi a titi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- FMCSA: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration, hukumar Amurka da ke kafa dokoki ga manyan motoci da bas.
- CLP: commercial learner's permit: izinin da ke bar ku yi atisayen tuƙin motar kasuwanci tare da mai CDL da ya cancanta kusa da ku.
- ELDT: entry-level driver training: horon tarayya da yawancin sababbin direbobin CDL dole su kammala kafin jarabawa.
- Training Provider Registry: jerin hukuma na FMCSA na makarantu da masu ɗaukar aiki da aka yarda su ba da ELDT.
- Likitan gwaji (medical examiner): ma'aikacin lafiya mai takardar shaida don yin gwajin lafiyar DOT ga direbobin motocin kasuwanci.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- 49 CFR 383.25: Commercial learner's permit (CLP)
- 49 CFR 380.603: Who must complete entry-level driver training
- FMCSA Training Provider Registry (ELDT)
- 49 CFR 391.11: Driver qualifications (age, English, medical)
- 49 CFR 391.45: When drivers must be medically examined
- 49 CFR 383.113: What the CDL skills test covers
Gwada yanzu: Ku nemo shafin CDL na jiharku (ku nemi sunan jiharku tare da "CDL" ku buɗe shafin .gov). Ku rubuta matakai shida a jere, kuma kusa da kowanne, abin da jiharku ta faɗa game da shi: fom, inda za ku je da kuɗin da ta lissafa.
Yanzu za ku iya jera matakai daga gwajin lafiya zuwa jarabawar ƙwarewa a jere, da faɗin wanda ke kula da kowanne.

check.q: Kun sami CLP ɗinku yanzu. Bayan yaushe za ku iya yin jarabawar ƙwarewa bisa dokokin tarayya?
options: A ranar
Washegari
Bayan watanni 6
Bayan aƙalla kwanaki 14
check.why: Dokokin tarayya sun ce mai CLP dole ya jira aƙalla kwanaki 14 kafin jarabawar ƙwarewa.

check.q: A ina za ku nemo makarantar da za ta iya ba da horon farko na direbobi da ake buƙata?
options: Kowace talla a kafofin sada zumunta
Training Provider Registry na FMCSA
Aboki da ke tuƙin babbar mota
Shagon sayar da motoci
check.why: Wuraren da ke cikin Training Provider Registry na FMCSA kaɗai ne za su iya ba da horon da ake buƙata.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Karatu don jarabawar rubutu
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tsara yadda za ku yi karatu da littafin CDL na jiharku, da ci maki a rukunin tambayoyin gwaji.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da littafin CDL na jiharku na kyauta, za ku iya tsara yadda za ku yi karatu don jarabawar rubutu da kuke buƙata, da ci maki a rukunin tambayoyin gwaji, kuna samun aƙalla 8 cikin 10 a tambayoyin gwaji kafin ku shirya ranar jarabawa.
Kowace jiha tana da littafin CDL kyauta a shafinta na lasisin tuƙi. Jarabawar rubutu daga cikinsa ake ɗauko ta, don haka shi ne littafin karatu mafi kyau da za ku iya samu.
Yawancin sababbin direbobi suna yin jarabawar General Knowledge (ilimi na gaba ɗaya). Da yawa kuma suna yin Air Brakes (birki na iska, domin yawancin manyan motoci suna amfani da shi) da Combination Vehicles (motoci masu haɗe, don Aji A). Kowane ƙarin izini yana da nasa jarabawar. Littafin jiharku yana faɗin waɗanne sassa ne na wace jarabawa.
Ku karanta sashe ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya. Ku karanta shi, ku rufe littafin, ku rubuta abubuwa uku da kuka koya. Sannan ku yi amfani da tambayoyin gwaji a cikin littafin ko a shafin jiharku. Ku yi ƙoƙarin samun aƙalla 8 cikin 10 daidai kafin ku shirya ranar jarabawa ta gaske.
Ku yi hankali da manhajoji da shafukan intanet na kuɗi da ke alƙawarin "ainihin tambayoyin jarabawa". Atisaye kyauta daga jiharku ya isa ga yawancin mutane.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku sauke littafin CDL na jiharku daga shafin .gov na hukuma.
- Ku yi alama a sassan da kuke buƙata: General Knowledge tare da na ajinku da ƙarin izininku.
- Ku tsara sashe ɗaya a kowane zaman karatu, minti 20 zuwa 30.
- Bayan kowane sashe, ku rubuta abubuwa uku da kuka koya ba tare da duba ba.
- Ku yi tambayoyin gwaji har sai kun sami aƙalla 8 cikin 10 daidai.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Jarabawar rubutu (knowledge test): jarabawar rubutu (sau da yawa a kwamfuta) da kuke ci don samun CLP ɗinku.
- Birki na iska (air brakes): birki da iska mai matsi ke sarrafawa, da ake amfani da shi a yawancin manyan motoci da bas.
- Littafin CDL (CDL manual): littafin karatu na hukuma na jiharku don jarabawar CDL.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FMCSA: Commercial Driver's License (the official federal CDL pages)
Gwada yanzu: Ku sauke littafin CDL na jiharku. Ku karanta farkon sashen General Knowledge game da binciken mota. Ku rufe shi ku rubuta abubuwa uku da kuka tuna. Sannan ku rubuta naku tambayoyin gwaji biyar da amsoshinsu, ku musanya da abokin karatu ko ku duba su da littafin.
Yanzu za ku iya nemo littafin CDL na jiharku, zaɓar sassan da kuke buƙata, da karanta su a gajerun zamuna har ku sami 8 cikin 10.

check.q: Mene ne littafin karatu kyauta mafi kyau don jarabawar rubutu ta CDL?
options: Manhajar kuɗi mai "ainihin amsoshin jarabawa"
Bidiyo daga baƙo a intanet
Littafin CDL na hukuma na jiharku
Littafin direbobin ƙananan motoci
check.why: Jarabawar rubutu daga littafin CDL na hukuma na jiharku take.

check.q: Kuna son Aji A don tarakta da tirela masu birki na iska. Waɗanne jarabawa kuke yawan buƙata?
options: School Bus kaɗai
Passenger kaɗai
Hazardous Materials kaɗai
General Knowledge, Air Brakes da Combination Vehicles
check.why: Yawancin direbobin tarakta da tirela na Aji A suna yin General Knowledge, Air Brakes da Combination Vehicles.

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Binciken mota kafin tafiya
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Faɗin sunan kowane wuri na binciken mota kafin tafiya da abin da kuke dubawa a wurin.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Kuna tsaye kusa da babbar mota ko kuna amfani da hotonta, za ku iya faɗin sunan kowane sashe da kuke dubawa a binciken mota kafin tafiya, da abin da kuke dubawa a kansa, kuna rufe dukkan manyan wurare a jere ba tare da tsallake wani wuri ba.
Jarabawar ƙwarewa tana farawa da binciken mota kafin tafiya (pre-trip inspection). Kuna zagaya motar, kuna nuna kowane sashe, kuna faɗin abin da kuke dubawa da babbar murya. Dokokin tarayya kuma sun ce kowane direba dole ya tabbata motar tana lafiya kafin ya tuƙa ta, don haka wannan al'ada ce ta tsawon aikinku.
Ku bi jeri ɗaya kowane lokaci, don kada ku taɓa tsallake wani sashe. Jerin da aka saba shi ne: ɗakin injin, gidan direba da kunna injin, sitiyari, sasfensan (suspension), birki, ƙafafu da tayoyi, gefuna da baya tare da fitilu, da wurin haɗi a mota mai haɗe. A motoci masu birki na iska kuma kuna duba ma'aunan birki na iska da alamun gargaɗinsu.
Ga kowane sashe, ku faɗi abin da ke sa shi lafiya: "A ɗaure yake da ƙarfi, babu tsagewa ko lanƙwasa, babu zubewa." Littafin jiharku yana da cikakken jerin don irin motarku. Wurin horonku zai nuna muku a babbar mota ta gaske.
Idan kun sami lahani, motar ba za ta motsa ba har sai an gyara shi. Ku kai rahoto ku rubuta shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku yi amfani da jerin bincike daga littafin jiharku don irin motarku.
- Ku fara a ɗakin injin, sannan gidan direba, sannan ku zagaya motar a jeri ɗaya kowane lokaci.
- Ku nuna kowane sashe ku faɗi abin da kuke dubawa: a ɗaure, ba a lalace ba, babu zubewa.
- Ku duba fitilu, abubuwan haskawa (reflectors) da tayoyi a kowane gefe.
- Ku rubuta ku kai rahoton duk wani lahani; kada ku tuƙa har sai an gyara shi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Binciken mota kafin tafiya (pre-trip inspection): binciken lafiya da direba ke yi wa mota kafin ya tuƙa ta.
- Lahani (defect): sashe da ya karye, ya gaji ko ya ɓace, wanda ke sa mota ta zama marar lafiya.
- Wurin haɗi (coupling): sassan da ke haɗa tarakta da tirela, kamar fifth wheel da kingpin.
- Fifth wheel: faffaɗan farantin zagaye a kan tarakta da tirelar ke kullewa a kai.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- 49 CFR 383.113: What the CDL skills test covers
- 49 CFR 396.13: Driver inspection before driving
Gwada yanzu: Ta amfani da sashen bincike na littafin CDL na jiharku, ku rubuta jerin binciken kafin tafiya don motar da kuke shirin yin jarabawa da ita. Sannan ku yi atisayen faɗin sa da babbar murya a kan ƙaramar mota, hoton babbar mota, ko motar wasa: ku nuna kowane wuri ku faɗi abin da kuke dubawa.
Yanzu za ku iya bin binciken mota kafin tafiya a jere, da faɗin abin da kuke dubawa a kowane sashe.

check.q: Me yasa kuke bincike a jeri ɗaya kowane lokaci?
options: Don kada ku taɓa tsallake wani sashe
Domin tsallake sassa ya fi sauri
Domin mai jarabawa ne ke zaɓar jerin
Ba shi da muhimmanci
check.why: Jeri ɗaya na nufin babu wurin da zai ɓace.

check.q: A binciken kafin tafiya kun sami bututun birki da ya tsage. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku tuƙa a hankali zuwa tasha ta gaba
Ku naɗe shi da tef ku tafi
Ku kai rahoto, ku rubuta, kuma kada ku tuƙa har sai an gyara shi
Ku ƙyale shi idan birkin yana aiki har yanzu
check.why: Lahanin lafiya yana nufin motar ba za ta motsa ba har sai an gyara ta.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Sarrafa mota na asali da halayen tuƙi lafiya
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Zaɓar mataki mai lafiya a yanayin tuƙin babbar mota da aka saba gani.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku wani yanayin tuƙi, za ku iya zaɓar mataki mai lafiya game da tazara, gudu, tuƙin baya da lafiyar direba, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin yanayi 5 daidai.
Bayan binciken kafin tafiya, jarabawar ƙwarewa tana duba sarrafa mota na asali (tafiya gaba da baya, tuƙin baya a layi madaidaici da a kwana, da juyawa) da tuƙi a titi.
Masu jarabawa suna neman halaye masu lafiya. Ku bar babbar tazara a kewaye da motarku: manyan motoci suna buƙatar wuri mai yawa sosai don tsayawa fiye da ƙananan motoci. Ku rage gudu idan ana ruwan sama, dusar ƙanƙara, a kwana, wuraren aikin gina titi da cunkoso, ko da ƙasa da iyakar gudu. Ku duba nesa a gaba kuma ku duba madubanku akai-akai. Ku yi juyawar dama mai faɗi a hankali don kada tirelar ta bugi gefen titi ko wata mota.
Ku yi tuƙin baya kaɗan yadda ya yiwu. Idan ba ku da tabbacin abin da ke bayanku, ku fita ku duba. Direbobi da yawa suna tunawa da G.O.A.L.: Get Out And Look (ku fita ku duba).
Dole kuma ku kasance cikin koshin lafiyar tuƙi. Dokokin tarayya na hours of service (sa'o'in aiki) suna iyakance tsawon lokacin da za ku iya tuƙi da aiki kafin ku huta, kuma ana yi wa direbobi gwajin ƙwayoyi da barasa. Kada ku taɓa tuƙi idan kun gaji, kuna rashin lafiya ko kun sha wani abu da ke rage hankali.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku bar babbar tazara a gaba; ku ƙara ta idan yanayi ya yi muni.
- Ku daidaita gudunku da titi, yanayi da kaya, ba alamar titi kaɗai ba.
- Ku duba madubanku bayan 'yan daƙiƙoƙi da kuma kafin kowane canjin layi.
- Kafin tuƙin baya: ku fita ku duba (Get Out And Look), sannan ku yi baya a hankali.
- Ku tsaya ku huta idan kun gaji; ku bi dokokin hours of service.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tazarar tsaro (space cushion): fili da kuke barin a kewaye da motarku don ku sami wurin tsayawa ko kauce wa abu.
- Off-tracking: lokacin da ƙafafun baya na doguwar mota suke bin gajeriyar hanya fiye da na gaba a lokacin juyawa.
- Hours of service: dokokin FMCSA kan tsawon lokacin da direba zai iya tuƙi da aiki kafin ya huta.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- 49 CFR 383.113: What the CDL skills test covers
- FMCSA: Hours of service rules
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta yanayi biyar daga sashen tuƙi lafiya na littafin jiharku (misali ruwan sama da dare, wurin aikin titi, tuƙin baya zuwa wurin sauke kaya). Ga kowanne, ku rubuta mataki mai lafiya a jimla ɗaya. Ku nemi abokin karatu ya yi muku tambayoyi a kansu.
Yanzu za ku iya zaɓar mataki mai lafiya game da tazara, gudu, tuƙin baya da lafiyar tuƙi.

check.q: Kuna tuƙin baya zuwa wurin sauke kaya kuma ba kwa ganin wani kusurwa. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku ƙara gudu a baya don ku gama da sauri
Ku fita ku duba kafin ku ci gaba da tuƙin baya
Ku busa ƙaho ku ci gaba
Ku yi amfani da rediyo kaɗai
check.why: G.O.A.L.: ku fita ku duba idan ba ku da tabbacin abin da ke bayanku.

check.q: Ruwan sama mai ƙarfi ya fara a babban titi. Mene ne zaɓi mai lafiya?
options: Ku ci gaba da gudu da tazara iri ɗaya
Ku matsa kusa da motar gaba don ku ga fitilunta
Ku ƙara gudu don ku fita daga ruwan sama
Ku rage gudu ku ƙara tazara tsakaninku da motar gaba
check.why: Titi mai ruwa yana nufin tsayawa yana ɗaukar nisa mai tsawo, don haka ku rage gudu ku bar wuri mai yawa.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Zaɓar horo da yin shirin CDL ɗinku
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Rubuta shirin CDL mai ranaku tare da wuraren horo masu rajista da za ku iya tuntuɓa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da majiyoyin hukuma na FMCSA da na jiha, za ku iya jera matakai daga gwajin lafiya zuwa jarabawar ƙwarewar CDL a jere daidai, ba tare da wani mataki ya ɓace ba, kuma da lokacin jira da dokar horo a ciki. Ta amfani da littafin CDL na jiharku na kyauta, za ku iya tsara yadda za ku yi karatu don jarabawar rubutu da kuke buƙata, da ci maki a rukunin tambayoyin gwaji, kuna samun aƙalla 8 cikin 10 a tambayoyin gwaji kafin ku shirya ranar jarabawa.
Kafin ku biya ko ku shiga kowane horo, ku tabbata makarantar ko mai ɗaukar aikin yana cikin Training Provider Registry na FMCSA. Kuna iya bincika jerin ta wuri.
Wasu kamfanonin manyan motoci suna biyan kuɗin horo idan kun yarda za ku yi musu tuƙi na wani ƙayyadadden lokaci. Ku karanta yarjejeniyar a hankali: me zai faru idan kun bar aiki da wuri? Za ku mayar da kuɗin horon? Ku tambaya kafin ku sa hannu.
Tsofaffin sojoji: idan kun tuƙa manyan motocin soja, ku tambayi jiharku game da military skills test waiver (keɓewa daga jarabawar ƙwarewa ga sojoji); FMCSA tana bar jihohi su ba da shi ga sojoji da tsofaffin sojoji na kwanan nan da suka cancanta. Idan kuna da tarihin laifi, ku kira ofishin lasisi na jiha ku tambayi masu ɗaukar aiki game da dokokin ɗaukar ma'aikata tun da wuri; izinin kayan haɗari kuma yana buƙatar binciken tsaro.
Yanzu ku mayar da shi shiri. Shiri mai ranaku ya fi yiwuwa ya faru fiye da buri kawai.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta aikin da kuke so da ajin da ƙarin izinin da yake buƙata.
- Ku bincika Training Provider Registry ku lissafa wurare uku kusa da ku.
- Ku kira ko ku ziyarta; ku tambayi game da jadawali, jimillar kuɗi, yarjejeniya da samar da aiki.
- Ku sa ranar da kuke nufi kusa da kowane mataki, daga gwajin lafiya zuwa jarabawar ƙwarewa.
- Ku tsara waɗanne sassan littafi za ku karanta kowane mako.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Yarjejeniyar horo (training contract): yarjejeniya cewa kamfani zai biya kuɗin horonku idan kun yi masa aiki na ƙayyadadden lokaci.
- Keɓewa daga jarabawar ƙwarewa (skills test waiver): zaɓi da wasu jihohi ke bayarwa na tsallake jarabawar ƙwarewar CDL ga direbobin soja da suka cancanta.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FMCSA Training Provider Registry (ELDT)
- 49 CFR 383.77: Skills test waiver for military drivers
- 49 CFR 380.603: Who must complete entry-level driver training
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: Heavy and tractor-trailer truck drivers
Gwada yanzu: Ku bincika Training Provider Registry don wurare uku kusa da ku. Ku rubuta sunayensu, yadda za a tuntuɓe su, da tambayoyi uku da za ku yi wa kowanne. Sannan ku sa ranar da kuke nufi kusa da kowane mataki na hanyar CDL ɗinku.
Yanzu za ku iya tabbatar cewa wurin horo yana da rajista, da rubuta shirin CDL mai rana ga kowane mataki.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Lasisin da ya dace Ajin ko ƙarin izinin bai dace da aikin ba, ko ba a rubuta su ba. Ajin da kowane ƙarin izini sun dace da aikin da ake nufi da tallar aiki ta gaske. Ya kuma ambaci wani aiki na biyu da lasisin zai buɗe, ko ƙarin izinin da za a ƙara daga baya. Matakai a jere Wasu matakai sun ɓace ko ba a jere suke ba, ko ba a sa dokar horo ko jiran kwanaki 14 ba. Dukkan matakai suna a jere tare da ranar da ake nufi ga kowanne, har da gwajin lafiya, CLP, horo da jiran kwanaki 14. Kowane mataki kuma yana ambaton ofishin ko shafin intanet da ke kula da shi. Horo mai rajista Babu wuraren horo, ko ba a duba wuraren a jerin ba. Wurare uku daga Training Provider Registry tare da bayanan tuntuɓa. Ya haɗa da amsoshin tambayoyin da aka yi: kuɗi, jadawali, sharuɗɗan yarjejeniya. Shirin karatu Babu shirin karatu, ko bai yi amfani da littafin jiha ba. Sassan littafin jiha na kowane mako don kowace jarabawa da ake buƙata, tare da burin makin atisaye. Ya haɗa da makin atisaye da aka riga aka samu. Jerin binciken kafin tafiya Jerin yana tsallake manyan wurare ko ba a jeri ɗaya yake ba. Ya rufe kowane babban wuri a jeri ɗaya, tare da abin da za a duba a kowane sashe. Mai koyo zai iya faɗin sa da babbar murya, yana nuna sassan, ba tare da karantawa ba. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake duba shirinku.

check.q: Wata makaranta ta ce tana ba da horon CDL amma ba ta cikin Training Provider Registry. Me ya kamata ku yi?
options: Ku shiga da sauri kafin farashi ya hau
Ku biya da kuɗi hannu don ya fi arha
Ku zaɓi wurin horo da ke cikin jerin
Ku nemi aboki ya duba muku daga baya
check.why: Horon da ake ƙirgawa ga yawancin sababbin direbobi dole ya fito daga wurin da ke cikin jerin FMCSA.

check.q: Wane shiri ne ya fi yiwuwa ya yi aiki?
options: "Zan sami CDL ɗina wata rana."
"Gwajin lafiya kafin 3 ga Mayu, jarabawar rubutu kafin 24 ga Mayu, sashen littafi ɗaya kowane mako."
"Zan yi karatu idan na sami lokaci."
"Zan yi jarabawar in ga abin da zai faru."
check.why: Shiri mai ranaku da matakan karatu na kowane mako yana mayar da buri zuwa ayyuka.
